description: The plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of various Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) methods as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$).", uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10 with tick marks spaced every 2 units. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10", uses a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5 with tick marks spaced every 0.5 units. A solid black horizontal line without markers spans the entire x-axis at a constant y-value of approximately 34.25. The "DPR w/ gold" method is represented by a solid yellow-olive line with circular markers; it begins below the y-axis minimum at x=1, crosses 33.0 near x=4, and rises steadily to end at approximately 34.95 at x=10. The "DPR w/ top-1" method is shown as a solid green line with circular markers, starting below 33.0 at x=1, rising sharply to roughly 34.7 at x=2, and continuing an upward trend to reach approximately 36.4 at x=10; a corresponding green dashed line remains constant across the plot at roughly 34.65. The "DPR w/ bottom-1" method, depicted by a solid purple line with circular markers, starts at approximately 34.75 at x=1, peaks at roughly 35.05 at x=3, and gradually declines to end at approximately 34.7 at x=10, with a corresponding purple dashed line constant at roughly 34.9. The "DPR w/ random" method is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, beginning at roughly 34.75 at x=1, rising to approximately 35.3 at x=4, and remaining relatively steady to end at roughly 35.3 at x=10; its corresponding blue dashed line is constant at approximately 35.2. Finally, the "DPR w/ curriculum" method is shown as a solid red line with circular markers, starting at approximately 35.15 at x=1, rising to roughly 35.55 at x=2, and gradually increasing to plateau around 35.8 from x=6 to x=10; a corresponding red dashed line remains constant at approximately 35.6.
